gloss: to speak up; to voice an objection; to have something to say

definitions.gloss: to speak up; to voice an objection; to have something to say
definitions.explanation: To express a complaint, objection, or opinion, especially toward someone in a position of authority or power. Carries an assertive, sometimes confrontational tone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{物申|ものもう}す。
examples.english: I have something to say about politics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{物申|ものもう}す⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: Few people have the courage to speak up against those in power.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{物申|ものもう}して、⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: She boldly spoke up against the company's policies and pushed through internal reforms.

notes:
A somewhat formal or literary expression combining ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing, matter) with ⟦{申|もう}す→申す：01319_mousu⟧ (the humble form of ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧, to say). Despite containing the humble verb ⟦{申|もう}す→申す：01319_mousu⟧, the expression as a whole conveys assertiveness — speaking truth to power. It has a slightly archaic flavor that adds weight and dignity to the act of speaking out.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{物申|ものもう}す: to speak up against authority
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{物申|ものもう}す: to speak out about society
- ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{物申|ものもう}す: to speak out about politics
- {物申|ものもう}す⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: an attitude of speaking up

USAGE:
Often used in headlines, opinion columns, and social commentary. The pattern 「〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{物申|ものもう}す」 is especially common as a title format for essays or speeches criticizing something.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{異議|いぎ}を{唱|とな}える→異議を唱える：19072_igiwotonaeru⟧: to raise an objection — more formal and procedural
- ⟦{抗議|こうぎ}する→抗議する：26923_kougisuru⟧: to protest — stronger, implies organized opposition
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give one's opinion — more neutral, less confrontational
